readerCopy.body: The obstacle in front of everyone can keep consuming energy while the decision that would change the larger pattern remains untouched. When Mars squares the North Node, conflict and forward movement create friction, making the same emergency, deadline, or source of frustration feel more urgent than the structural choice underneath it. The anger can be justified without another victory in the old fight creating a new result. Action becomes more consequential when some of the force reaches the arrangement itself.
